subject: Post-discovery: lock a 30min demo & nominate ops liaison
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@cloudedge.com>, Oliver Park <oliver.park@cloudedge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery recap + 30m demo options

Hi Samantha / Oliver — thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key goals you shared: reduce inference cost on bursty workloads, guarantee 99th%-tile latency for chat, and centralize observability across teams.
- What we’ll show in the 30m session: short product tour (10m), relevant latency/cost dashboards (10m), and a short Q&A on integration points (10m).

To make scheduling simple, can you confirm which of these 30-minute windows works best for your team (we can also accommodate a different time if needed):

1) Wed Sep 16 — 10:00–10:30 PT
2) Thu Sep 17 — 14:00–14:30 PT
3) Fri Sep 18 — 08:30–09:00 PT

Also: please nominate an ops/SRE liaison who will join the session (we typically walk through network requirements, KV cache behavior, and deployment options with that person). Ben and Kim from our side will cover the platform and deployment questions.

I attached the short discovery notes and a proposed demo agenda for visibility. If those times don’t work, tell us two slots that do and we’ll prioritize the ops attendee.

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference
